channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Hassan Whiteside | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Hassan Whiteside from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Quin Snyder on Hassan Whiteside
item.description:
Ryan Miller:Quin Snyder on having to play smaller with Whiteside out:

“It is something that we've anticipated throughout the season and something we've wanted to do as well. ... It's ironic that this is the game where it happens — we're playing against three 7 footers.”

Quin Snyder on Hassan Whiteside, Dec 5, 2021. Source: Twitter @millerjryan.

item.title: Justin Zanik on Hassan Whiteside
item.description:
Ben Anderson:Justin Zanik on the marriage between the @Utah Jazz and Hassan Whiteside:

“I think the role that we had was a real role every night. And in the event of injuries he's a guy that started games for playoff teams.”

Justin Zanik on Hassan Whiteside, Aug 6, 2021. Source: Twitter @BensHoops.

item.title: Kelly Olynyk on Hassan Whiteside
item.description:
“Hassan is a great guy to play beside because he’s really an anchor defensively and on the offensive glass he can really cause havoc,”

Kelly Olynyk on Hassan Whiteside, Oct 1, 2018. Source: Miami Herald.

item.title: Goran Dragic on Amare Stoudemire, Steve Nash, Hassan Whiteside, Udonis Haslem, Grant Hill
item.description:
Goran Dragic on Udonis Haslem continued:

“A lot of guys in this locker room need leadership like UD, especially Hassan [Whiteside]. I think UD can provide that. He's there where usually some guys would not be, in the toughest moments, when you need something, he's there. That's why everybody loves him. I played with a lot of veteran guys who had successful careers — like UD, Steve Nash, Grant Hill, Amare Stoudemire — [and Haslem] is number one in my books as a player and a leader and a friend.”

Goran Dragic on Amare Stoudemire, Steve Nash, Hassan Whiteside, Udonis Haslem, Grant Hill, May 11, 2018. Source: Miami Herald.

item.title: Pat Riley on Hassan Whiteside, Erik Spoelstra
item.description:
Riley, on Spoelstra playing Whiteside limited minutes in postseason:

“I would have taken him out of the game, too, the way he was performing.”

Pat Riley on Hassan Whiteside, Erik Spoelstra, Apr 30, 2018. Source: Twitter @flasportsbuzz.

item.title: Udonis Haslem on Hassan Whiteside
item.description:
“With Hassan, when you talk to him, you have got to be calm, you got to be direct and you got to be up front and honest with him about what’s going on and what you need from him and what he needs to be doing. You don’t have to yell at Hassan to get him going. I felt everybody needed to hear Hassan's side of things and hash it out and move forward. He didn't like the way [his comments] came out. He wasn’t happy about the decision he made. He knew he could have done it differently. We expect [in the future] he's going to be better.”

Udonis Haslem on Hassan Whiteside, Apr 13, 2018. Source: Miami Herald.

item.title: Erik Spoelstra on Dwyane Wade, Hassan Whiteside
item.description:
Spoelstra on Wade and Whiteside:

“They're not playing tonight. That's all I know. We're playing it day by day. Nothing like being in the present moment.”

Erik Spoelstra on Dwyane Wade, Hassan Whiteside, Mar 12, 2018. Source: Twitter @IraHeatBeat.

item.title: Joel Embiid on Hassan Whiteside
item.description:
Embiid on Whiteside (1/2):

“Looking at the replay it looked like I didn’t touch him. Then they called a double foul. Tried hit me in the back, which is kind of dirty because of the fact that I’ve had back problems. So we’re going to see about that. I won’t forget about that...”

Joel Embiid on Hassan Whiteside, Mar 9, 2018. Source: Twitter @JCameratoNBCS.

item.title: Erik Spoelstra on Hassan Whiteside
item.description:
Anthony Chiang:Spo on Hassan:

“He's been working out twice a day. One workout is always a non-impact, full conditioning workout either on the bike or in the pool. Then the last few days, he's been doing court work and he's been making a lot of progress.”

Erik Spoelstra on Hassan Whiteside, Dec 23, 2017. Source: Twitter @Anthony_Chiang.

item.title: Erik Spoelstra on Hassan Whiteside
item.description:
Ira Winderman:Spoelstra on Whiteside's new bone bruise:

“I think he feels much better and so do we, now that he knows what it is.”

Erik Spoelstra on Hassan Whiteside, Dec 1, 2017. Source: Twitter @IraHeatBeat.

item.title: Tyronn Lue on Hassan Whiteside, Dwight Howard, Andre Drummond, Joel Embiid
item.description:
Tyronn Lue said of Kevin Love.

“He has some tough matchups over the last six games. Two with Dwight Howard, Joel Embiid, Whiteside, Andre Drummond and he's been great. He's shooting the ball better. I think he's taken a liking to the 5 because he knows he's going to get open shots and if teams put smaller guys on him, we're going to be able to post him. He's been great.”

Tyronn Lue on Hassan Whiteside, Dwight Howard, Andre Drummond, Joel Embiid, Dec 1, 2017. Source: Cleveland Plain Dealer.

item.title: Goran Dragic on Hassan Whiteside
item.description:
Hassan Whiteside responded to their request by pointing the finger back at them after Tuesday’s practice, urging them to be patient when using his screens.

“Me and Dion were in the paint all night. I felt like Hassan was great,”

Goran Dragic on Hassan Whiteside, Nov 23, 2017. Source: Palm Beach Post.

item.title: Joel Embiid on Hassan Whiteside
item.description:
“I wish I could have had a quadruple-double with blocks, shoutout [Miami Heat center] Hassan Whiteside,”

Joel Embiid on Hassan Whiteside, Nov 16, 2017. Source: Philadelphia Inquirer.

item.title: Erik Spoelstra on Hassan Whiteside
item.description:
“We've had different guys finish. There's a certain standard of how we want to play. And different things happen in different games, and you just need to be emotionally stable to learn, to adapt, to be ready for the next game and produce for your teammates. But Hassan was tremendous [Wednesday]. He had a great motor, great disposition. His focus level was extremely high. He knows how important he is for our success. When he's playing at this kind of level, this ballclub can win a lot of games.”

Erik Spoelstra on Hassan Whiteside, Nov 9, 2017. Source: South Florida Sun-Sentinel.

item.title: James Johnson on Hassan Whiteside
item.description:
Johnson said of why he ran to Whiteside’s defense.

“We’re building something here, and he was being aggressive and physical. Whiteside went down and that’s all I remember after that.”

James Johnson on Hassan Whiteside, Feb 2, 2017. Source: Miami Herald.

item.title: Pat Riley on Hassan Whiteside
item.description:
Manny Navarro:Pat Riley on Hassan Whiteside:

“The 32 and 15, I'm glad he's frustrated. He had 32 and 15 and wasn't happy after the game. But I think venting his frustration in another form is the best way to go about it.”

Pat Riley on Hassan Whiteside, Dec 21, 2016. Source: Twitter @Manny_Navarro.

item.title: Pat Riley on Hassan Whiteside
item.description:
Manny Navarro:Pat Riley:

“What Hassan should do is walk in with a clipboard and a pen and diagram some plays he likes. I'm sure his coach will be amenable.”

Pat Riley on Hassan Whiteside, Dec 21, 2016. Source: Twitter @Manny_Navarro.

item.title: DeMarcus Cousins on Hassan Whiteside
item.description:
Cousins said of Whiteside before Tuesday’s game.

“His talent has always been there.… At one point, I thought Hassan was a better player than me. Everything he’s doing now, I thought he was capable of doing then.”

DeMarcus Cousins on Hassan Whiteside, Nov 2, 2016. Source: Palm Beach Post.

item.title: DeMarcus Cousins on Hassan Whiteside
item.description:
Manny Navarro:DeMarcus Cousins on Hassan Whiteside :

“I was always a fan of Hassan. At one point I thought Hassan was a better player than me. His talent was always there. I mean I remember days where it would just be me and him working out 1-on-1 and he would kill me. I'm happy for him, happy for the situation he's in now. He's proved a lot of people wrong.”

DeMarcus Cousins on Hassan Whiteside, Nov 1, 2016. Source: Twitter @Manny_Navarro.

item.title: Pat Riley on Hassan Whiteside, Josh Richardson, Justise Winslow, Tyler Johnson
item.description:
“But at the same time, Coach's attitude and my attitude is we want to win. And we don't know what we really have. But we love Hassan (Whiteside), we love Josh (Richardson) and Justise (Winslow) and Tyler (Johnson) and a lot of the other young players that we have, so I think from that standpoint, it's a wait and let's see what happens. And then we'll go from there. We're rebuilding now. We're not tweaking, like we did with the Big Three team. Or retooling, like we had to do right after LeBron left. We're rebuilding, but we're rebuilding to win now.”

Pat Riley on Hassan Whiteside, Josh Richardson, Justise Winslow, Tyler Johnson, Sep 26, 2016. Source: CBSSports.com.

item.title: Micky Arison on Chris Bosh, Hassan Whiteside, Pat Riley, Udonis Haslem, Erik Spoelstra, Goran Dragic, Josh McRoberts, Josh Richardson, Justise Winslow, Tyler Johnson
item.description:
Toward the close of the email, Arison wrote:

“What won't change is the culture of this organization. The Miami HEAT is a Championship organization. I fully expect this team, from Pat Riley to Head Coach Erik Spoelstra, to our veterans Chris Bosh, Udonis Haslem, Goran Dragic and Josh McRoberts, to our returning young core of Hassan Whiteside, Justise Winslow, Josh Richardson and Tyler Johnson, to the fresh faces joining the HEAT Family to continue our mantra of being the 'hardest working, best conditioned, most professional, unselfish, toughest, meanest, nastiest team in the NBA.'”

Micky Arison on Chris Bosh, Hassan Whiteside, Pat Riley, Udonis Haslem, Erik Spoelstra, Goran Dragic, Josh McRoberts, Josh Richardson, Justise Winslow, Tyler Johnson, Aug 12, 2016. Source: South Florida Sun-Sentinel.

item.title: Justise Winslow on Hassan Whiteside
item.description:
Manny Navarro:Justise Winslow on Hassan Whiteside:

“To have him back there as the cornerstone of our franchise, it really means a lot. It's a good piece to start building.”

Justise Winslow on Hassan Whiteside, Jul 7, 2016. Source: Twitter @Manny_Navarro.

item.title: Pat Riley on Hassan Whiteside
item.description:
But Riley remains adamant about Whiteside's seemingly endless ceiling and has no desire to let him simply walk out the door.

“I want to build a team that can win, and (Whiteside's) got to be part of that,”

Pat Riley on Hassan Whiteside, May 19, 2016. Source: USA Today Sports.

item.title: Pat Riley on Hassan Whiteside
item.description:
“While there might be players out there in free agency, our No. 1 priority is Hassan Whiteside. He's 26 years old. He's a game changer. I don't think he's even reached his real ceiling in a couple areas of the game ...”

Pat Riley on Hassan Whiteside, May 19, 2016. Source: USA Today Sports.

item.title: Pat Riley on Hassan Whiteside
item.description:
Barry Jackson:Pat Riley on Hassan Whiteside:

“I want to build a team that can win and he's got to be a part of it.”

Pat Riley on Hassan Whiteside, May 18, 2016. Source: Twitter @flasportsbuzz.

item.title: Erik Spoelstra on Hassan Whiteside
item.description:
Spoelstra on Whiteside:

“He forced me to become a better coach in a lot of ways.... We spent a lot of time together.”

Erik Spoelstra on Hassan Whiteside, May 17, 2016. Source: Twitter @EthanJSkolnick.

item.title: Erik Spoelstra on Hassan Whiteside
item.description:
Spoelstra on Whiteside:

“He's a fun personality. He's different... as he always says. And it's true.”

Erik Spoelstra on Hassan Whiteside, May 17, 2016. Source: Twitter @EthanJSkolnick.

item.title: Erik Spoelstra on Hassan Whiteside
item.description:
Jason Lieser:Erik Spoelstra on coaching Hassan Whiteside:

“He’s not a guy that fits into your conventional, stereotypical box... He's different, as he always says.”

Erik Spoelstra on Hassan Whiteside, May 17, 2016. Source: Twitter @JasonLieser.

item.title: Shane Battier on Hassan Whiteside
item.description:
“It might’ve been my last year. Hassan was there – big, long, blocked a few shots. But after the sprints, he laid down on the floor. And I went over to him and said, ‘Man, get your ass up. Get your ass up. We just won two NBA titles and we’re going for a three-peat this year. Do you see LeBron laying down or Chris or D. Wade? Do you see Udonis Haslem laying down on the ground? Get up. You think Riles over there is gonna give you money if he sees you laying down?’ “Andto his credit, he got up really quickly and had a hangdog look on his face and was almost apologetic, but at that point I wrote him off. Man get this guy outta here.”

Shane Battier on Hassan Whiteside, Mar 30, 2016. Source: Palm Beach Post.

item.title: Amare Stoudemire on Hassan Whiteside
item.description:
Amare Stoudemire:

“With Hassan, it's about keeping him locked in. Making sure he understands the importance of details with the game of basketball. Fundamentals carry you a long way. Once you learn the details—the small things that add up to become big for us—that's gonna elevate his game even more. That's what we've been talking about with him all year. He's had a really good season, and we're ready to progress through the rest of the year.”

Amare Stoudemire on Hassan Whiteside, Mar 25, 2016. Source: Sports Illustrated.
